buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract

quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Provisions for workmen compensation, insurance, public liability, property damage, insurance etc. to be ensured by the contractor. Also, safety measures prescribed for working in Extra High Voltage & use of personnel protective equipment must be adhered to. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses · SCOPE OF WORK: Carry out Hot Line Washing of 400kV Bays, jack buses and interstate lines at 400 kV Switchyard PPS-III, Ba wana (04 cycles in a year). 400kV Switchyard PPS-III Bawana: Approximate List of equipments for Hotline Washing is as follow: 1. 400KV Circuit Breaker- 15 Sets 2. 400KV Isolator- 40 Sets 3. 400KV Post Insulators- 417 nos. 4. 400KV Double string insulators -14 Sets 5. 400KV Single string insulators -58 Sets 6. 390KV Surge arrester- 06 sets 7. Wave trap BPI 12 nos. Ø Technical Terms & Conditions: 1. The scope includes transportation of the Hot line washing equipment complete, mobile tanker along wit h all accessories, tools, tackles, etc. to the location of work inside the Plant and taking them out of the Plan t. 2. The washing shall be done with high pressure jet of DM Water from a safe distance of 8 to 12 feet. The p ressure of water shall be such that the jet should reach the last disc of insulator string and thoroughly clea n all the discs. 3. Two no. nozzles should be directed in the opposite direction from the lower most petticoat towards the upper direction slowly & finally reaching the terminal. 4. Conductivity of DM Water should be measured at the DM Plant as well as in the Switchyard just before u sing it. The normal value should be less than 5 µ Mho. 5. A leakage detector with a setting of 1 micro Amp is connected between the nozzle & nearby use (Groun d). The detector to be used should be got tested from the lab prior to use. If the leakage current exceeds more than 1 micro Amp it should give an alarm. 6. During Hot Line Water washing it should be ensured that the Water droplets do not fall on the un- clean ed insulators due to wind direction. 7. Hot Line Water Washing will not be carried out during the cloudy, Rainy, Moist, Foggy, Stormy, Windy & Dark conditions. 8. It will be ensured that Insulators are dry before starting the Hot Line Water Washing. 9. All the required personal protective equipments i.e. Hand Gloves, Shoes, helmet etc. should be worn by the personal carrying out this activity.

10. Electricity supply will be made available free of cost at nearest available point. 11. The firm will take all safety precautions during Hot Line Water Washing to avoid any flash over & will b e solely responsible in case flash-over occurs. 12. Washing shall be done with the contractor's equipment and trained crew under the direct supervision of duly authorized supervisor of the contractor. 13. The contractor shall be fully responsible for the safety of his workmen and shall take all the necessary safety precaution and fulfill all the statutory requirements regarding qualification, license and insurance of staff deputed for the job. Contractor shall arrange proper and sufficient number of safety equipment at his own cost as per the rules in-forced from time to time during the contract period. PPCL shall not be responsi ble for the safety of the personnel and the equipment of the agency. 14. All cleaning/washing shall be done as per the best engineering practices and to the satisfaction of Engi neer. Decision of PPCL regarding the acceptability and completion of cleaning /washing shall be final and b inding on the contractor. 15. None of the bays/equipment shall be de-energized exclusively for the purpose of washing of insulators/ equipment etc. 16. Mobilization Period &Completion Period: a) Mobilization Period: • The contractor shall mobilize the manpower at the work place within 20 days of issue of communication, unless otherwise directed by Engineer in-charge/representative of Switchyard for each cycle. b) Completion Period: i. The work of Hot Line Water Washing should be completed within 20 days for each cycle from the date of commencement of work. However, number of days on which work could not be carried out due to rainy, cl oudy, foggy season and non arrangement of PTW by PPCL will not be counted in the completion period. ii. Before commencement of work order of each cycle the firm will authorize a competent person who will r epresent the firm. All the direction given to such representative shall be binding as if given to firm. 17. The contract shall be valid for 2 years from the date of award of work. 18. Washing of the insulators of the switch yard shall be carried out with DM water. DM water will be provi ded by PPCL. Contractor shall make his own arrangement for transportation of DM water from DM water pl ant. 19. Contractor shall bring his mobile tanker, hot line washing equipment complete along with all accessori es, tools, tackles etc., required for carrying out the hot line washing job. Shifting of these equipment, tanke r, tools, tackles etc., within the plant is in the scope of the agency at no extra cost. · SPECIAL TERMS & CONDITIONS: 1. The Bidders should furnish the details of their experience and statement of past/current works of similar items to this tender. At least 2 Copies of successfully completed work orders and performance reports of si milar works from various CPSU's, state electricity board or other govt. department or any power utility dea ling with 220kV or above voltage class are to be submitted. 2. Bidder shall submit copy of competency certificate related to hot line washing of 220KV or above voltag e level. 3. The bidder should possess valid Electrical Contractor License. 4. The work of Hot Line Water Washing will be taken in hand by the firm within 30 days of issue of LOI/Wor k Order, whichever is earlier, unless otherwise directed by Engineer in-charge/representative of respective Switchyard for each cycle. 5. PO contract period validity shall be 2-years from the date of award of contract and completion period of individual activity shall be 20-days.

6. The vendor shall quote a uniform percentage (%) above or below the estimated cost in the Price Bid B OQ only. No separate item-wise rates shall be quoted. 7. Contract Agreement & Indemnity Bond: The successful bidder shall submit the following documents on non-judicial stamp papers in the prescribed PPCL format (attached with the bid for reference) before comm encement of work: (a) ContractAgreementonRs.100/-Non-Judicial Stamp Paper. (b) IndemnityBondonRs.10/-Non-Judicial Stamp Paper. The cost of stamp papers and execution of documents shall be borne by the bidder. 8. EMD may be furnished, details of which uploaded on web site, in any of the following forms. Demand Draft/Bankers Cheque/Bank Guarantee/ECS in favour of PPCL ECS may be done on IPGCL-PPCL website: https://ipgcl-ppcl.gov.in Note: No BG shall be accepted for EMD amount up to Rs. 25,000/-. 9. Security Deposit: A Security Deposit @ 5% of the total contract value shall be applicable in addition to the EPBG specified in the bid. The Security Deposit shall be retained until completion of the contract perio d plus an additional two (02) months. 10. INSTRUCTIONS REGARDING COMMON IP ADDRESS: Bidders are advised to note that if any bid is found to have a matching or common IP address with any oth er bidder on the Delhi Government e-Portal, all such bids shall be outrightly rejected without any further c ommunication and will not be considered for further evaluation. Special Note : The bidder shall quote only the percentage (+/–) above or below the total BOQ value . The quoted percentage shall be uniformly applicable to all activities/items of the BOQ. Any change in indi vidual unit rates shall not be permitted and, if quoted, the bid shall be liable for outright rejection/necessar y action. So please fill only Company/firm name and percentage (+/–) above or below tab in BOQ. .
